mapper.insert:
insert into eg_check_account_kingdee_result_his (record_id, period_code, org_id, account_code, currency_type, account_remain_balance, kingdee_remain_balance, diff_balance, diff_flag, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) select ${param.recordId},tmp.period_code, tmp.org_id, tmp.account_code, tmp.currency_type, COALESCE(tmp.account_remain_balance,'0'), case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then coalesce(ecakt.fend_balance_for,0) when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then coalesce(ecakt.fend_balance_for,0)*(-1) else 0 end kingdee_remain_balance, case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then coalesce(ecakt.fend_balance_for,0)-tmp.account_remain_balance when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then coalesce(ecakt.fend_balance_for,0)*(-1)-tmp.account_remain_balance else 0 end diff_balance, case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' and coalesce(ecakt.fend_balance_for,0) = tmp.account_remain_balance then '0' when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' and coalesce(ecakt.fend_balance_for,0)*(-1) = tmp.account_remain_balance then '0' else '1' end diff_flag, '0', ${param.createBy}, now(), ${param.updateBy}, now() from ( select #{param.periodCode}::integer period_code, coalesce(assist.org_id,voucher.org_id) org_id, coalesce(assist.account_code,voucher.account_code) account_code, coalesce(assist.currency_type,voucher.currency) currency_type, coalesce(assist.account_remain_balance,0)+ coalesce(voucher.account_remain_balance,0) account_remain_balance from ( select eaab.period_code , eaab.org_id , eaab.account_code , eaab.currency_code currency_type, -- sum(eaab.month_end_debit_balance) account_remain_balance, case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then coalesce(sum(eaab.month_end_debit_balance),0) - coalesce(sum(eaab.month_end_credit_balance),0) when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then coalesce(sum(eaab.month_end_credit_balance),0) - coalesce(sum(eaab.month_end_debit_balance),0) else 0 end account_remain_balance from eg_account_assist_balance eaab join eg_account ea on eaab.account_code = ea.account_code where eaab.period_code = #{param.lastPeriodCode} and eaab.del_flag = '0' and eaab.org_id in ('01-C0001', '02-C0001', '80001', '30001') and ea.check_flag = '1' group by eaab.period_code , eaab.org_id , eaab.account_code , eaab.currency_code, ea.debit_credit_type ) assist full outer join ( select ev.period_code, ev.org_id, eve.account_code, ev.currency, case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then coalesce(sum(eve.debit_amount),0) - coalesce(sum(eve.credit_amount),0) when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then coalesce(sum(eve.credit_amount),0) - coalesce(sum(eve.debit_amount),0) else 0 end account_remain_balance from eg_voucher ev join eg_voucher_entry eve on ev.id = eve.voucher_id join eg_account ea on eve.account_code = ea.account_code where ev.period_code = #{param.periodCode} and eve.period_code = #{param.periodCode} and ev.del_flag = '0' and ev.org_id in ('01-C0001', '02-C0001', '80001', '30001') and ea.check_flag = '1' group by ev.period_code , ev.org_id , eve.account_code , ev.currency, ea.debit_credit_type ) voucher on assist.org_id = voucher.org_id and assist.account_code = voucher.account_code and coalesce(assist.currency_type,'') = coalesce(voucher.currency,'')
)tmp join eg_check_account_kingdee_tmp ecakt on 1=1 and tmp.period_code = ecakt.period_code and tmp.org_id = ecakt.org_id and tmp.account_code = ecakt.account_code and tmp.currency_type = ecakt.currency_type join eg_account ea on ecakt.account_code = ea.account_code
